https://discord.com/channels/15289461343.summary: Your NAT-timeout theory is basically right. Chat runs on its own connection to a separate chat server, and it goes idle, so the router drops it.
https://discord.com/channels/15289461343.sourceText: Your NAT-timeout theory is basically right. Chat runs on its own connection to a separate chat server, and it goes idle, so the router drops it. DMZ working is the tell that it's the router's security/firewall layer, not port forwarding. Try in order: (1) turn off Cox "Advanced Security" in the Panoramic app / Spectrum "Security Shield" in the Spectrum app, which is the usual culprit; (2) set the router firewall to Low and disable IP flood detection / SIP ALG; (3) with chat connected, check Resource Monitor → Network → TCP Connections for eqgame.exe to see the actual chat-server port, forward exactly that, and reserve the laptop's IP. If the ISP box won't cooperate, bridge mode plus your own router fixes it for good.

https://discord.com/channels/15289461343.sourceText: Okay y'all, who's tech-savvy? Ever since I got a new Cox/Spectrum router, I can't stay in EverQuest chat channels for more than about 5 minutes before getting the "unavailable" message. Regular game traffic works fine. I've tried port forwarding, UPnP, and a bunch of troubleshooting. The only thing that fixes it is putting my laptop in the DMZ, which obviously isn't a long-term solution. It seems like the chat channel connection has NAT timing out issue on a separate port from the rest of the game?\ Has anyone run into this or know what router setting I should be looking at? Please send me a DM if you have any suggestions.

https://discord.com/channels/15289461343.summary: With the shaman cleric combo I’ve toyed around with optimizing the hate crawl and (solo not group) I have gotten the runs to be about 45 minutes for full crawl.
https://discord.com/channels/15289461343.sourceText: With the shaman cleric combo I’ve toyed around with optimizing the hate crawl and (solo not group) I have gotten the runs to be about 45 minutes for full crawl. You triple pull / double pull the mini bosses - stay in balanced to malo them all, then switch to evasion to DDD. Switch back to balanced when endurance is about 25% and then use first DA AA to heal up once low. Click it off once healed, canni for the mana in evasion stance, then DDD until low hp again and use second DA AA to heal up, then DDD until they’re dead (use overchannel). Speeds up the runs dramatically This is obviously not possible with the int set up. Canni makes a huge difference because that mana really matters. I’m doing this with 9.3k mana
